name: Netz
tagline: The multipiece mesh wheel from Breitspur 01.
lede: A three piece mesh wheel with a deep polished lip, drawn for the cars that wore mesh when it mattered.
story: Netz is German for net.  It is the wheel Breitspur 01 wears, and the first wheel from the studio.

Mesh is the most honest wheel there is.  Every spoke carries load and you can see all of it.  Netz keeps the fine weave and the deep lip, then redraws the center so the mesh reads cleanly from across a room.
It starts at 15 inches on purpose.  The cars that wore mesh first, from the 2002 to the E30, deserve a wheel that fits them without spacers or excuses.
specsNote: Planned specification.  Final sizes and fitments follow interest.
